fusions.name: Shot from the Hedge
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Singing Shafts
fusions.desc: Looses 3 whistling arrows at once, spread apart, out to 7 tiles, each dealing 7 damage with a 25% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rigged in the Brush
fusions.desc: Props a strung bow in cover for 15 seconds. It shoots an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bead on the Quarry
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
